summary: An AnsibleAutomationPlatformBackup can set backup_pvc, backup_storage_class, backup_storage_requirements and create_backup_pvc globally (for the platform gateway) and override them under controller, eda and hub; apply it with oc apply -f.
questions: How do I define custom PVCs for AAP backups?
Set backup_storage_class for the controller backup

answer_card.title: Custom backup PVCs
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
apiVersion: aap.ansible.com/v1alpha1
kind: AnsibleAutomationPlatformBackup
metadata:
  name: aapbackup
spec:
  deployment_name: aap
  backup_pvc: custom-aap-backup-pvc        # gateway
  backup_storage_class: nfs-local-rwx
  backup_storage_requirements: 7Gi
  create_backup_pvc: true
  controller:
    backup_pvc: custom-controller-backup-pvc
    backup_storage_class: standard-csi
    create_backup_pvc: true
```
Component values override the global ones. `oc apply -f custom-pvc-backup.yaml`.
